zh-Hans: 如果真有左右胜负的天运，那它现在正稳稳地流向我这边！
en: If there's such a thing as luck deciding a battle, it's definitely flowing my way now!

zh-Hans: 现在先豁出去，打起十二分精神盯紧他。战术的事，之后再想！
en: For now, I'll put everything into watching him closely. I can think about tactics afterward!

zh-Hans: 我一定会找出突破口！
en: I'll find an opening!

zh-Hans: 为什么我还能勉强跟住呢？
en: Why am I only just managing to keep up?

zh-Hans: 高明，重心转移真是运用得炉火纯青！
en: Brilliant. His weight transfer is exceptionally good!

zh-Hans: 沿着漂亮的路线一气呵成，真高明！
en: He flows through on such a clean line. Beautiful!

zh-Hans: 流畅得像流水，简直要把人吸进去。
en: It's so smooth and flowing, it draws you right in.

zh-Hans: 搞不懂，看得我头都晕了！
en: I don't understand it. My head's spinning!

zh-Hans: 真快，果然名不虚传，真的很快。
en: Fast. Just as I'd heard. He's really fast.

zh-Hans: 与其说厉害，不如说可怕！
en: That's not just impressive. It's scary!

zh-Hans: 不会吧……
en: No way...

zh-Hans: 哇！
en: Whoa!

zh-Hans: 呜！
en: Ugh!

zh-Hans: 好快，比预想的还快！
en: Fast. Faster than I expected!

zh-Hans: 失算了。
en: A miscalculation.

zh-Hans: 难以置信。
en: I don't believe it.

zh-Hans: 什么？
en: What?

zh-Hans: 超出预料。
en: Better than I expected.

zh-Hans: 好快，这动作真奇妙！
en: Fast! What unusual movement!

zh-Hans: 厉害。
en: Amazing.

zh-Hans: 先让他跑在前面吧。
en: I'll let him lead for now.

zh-Hans: 被摆了一道。怎么说呢，虽是对手，也帅得过分了。
en: He got me. What can I say? Even as an opponent, he's almost too cool.

zh-Hans: 他适应实战局面的能力，恐怕是天才级别的。
en: His ability to adapt in a real battle must be nothing short of genius.

zh-Hans: 虽是对手，也只能说精彩。
en: Opponent or not, I can only call that magnificent.

zh-Hans: 根本就跟不上。
en: There's no way I can keep up.

zh-Hans: 这种情况，在我的模拟里根本不可能出现！
en: This situation should be impossible in my simulation!

zh-Hans: 比想象中慢，是在隐藏实力吗？
en: Slower than I thought. Is he hiding his hand?

zh-Hans: 不能大意，趁现在拉开差距。
en: I can't relax. I'll build a lead while I can.

zh-Hans: 越上头，后轮的负担就越大。拖得越久，对我越有利！
en: The harder he pushes, the more load he puts on his rear tires. The longer this goes, the better for me!

zh-Hans: 开始有意思了。
en: This is getting interesting.

zh-Hans: 还真让我过瘾。
en: You're keeping me entertained.

zh-Hans: 好，看来还是我更快。
en: Good. It looks like I'm faster.

zh-Hans: 这样下去能赢，不过还不能大意。
en: I can win at this rate. But I can't let my guard down.

zh-Hans: 你的本事应该不止这些。
en: You should be better than this.

zh-Hans: 真意外，竟然能在这里超过去。
en: A surprise. I didn't expect to pass him here.

zh-Hans: 看来，也不是赢不了的对手。
en: It seems he's not unbeatable after all.

zh-Hans: 依我看，你还没完全掌握这条赛道。
en: As far as I can see, you haven't fully mastered this course yet.

zh-Hans: 技术是不错，不过有些地方还不够高效。
en: You're good, but there are parts where you're not efficient enough.

zh-Hans: 随别人怎么说，我就是想赢。
en: Say what you like. I want to win.

zh-Hans: 好，跟设想的一样。
en: Good. Just as I pictured it.

zh-Hans: 看来能行。
en: This looks promising.

zh-Hans: 抱歉了。
en: Sorry about that.

zh-Hans: 这样的话……
en: If this keeps up...
Whew...

zh-Hans: 完全没想到，就这点本事吗？
en: I never expected this. Is that all?

zh-Hans: 就这点本事吗？
en: Is that all?

zh-Hans: 是我看走眼了吗？怎么看都很慢。
en: Did I misjudge him? No matter how I look at it, he's slow.

zh-Hans: 没想象中快。虽然不能大意，但确实慢。
en: He's not as fast as I expected. I can't relax, but he is slow.

zh-Hans: 调动全部感官，把它刻进身体里。来吧，让我看清那超人技术和速度的本质！
en: I'll use every sense and burn it into my body. Show me the essence of that superhuman skill and speed!
